name: 08 Marcus — Stage 1 Manual PDF Test / Stage 2 Parked

parameters.content:
# STAGE 1 · MANUAL PDF TEST

1. Open **2 · TEST INPUTS — EDIT ME**.
2. Enter the question, spread type, first name and last name.
3. Click **Execute workflow**.
4. Open **9 · REPORT READY — DOWNLOAD PDF**, choose **Binary**, then download `data`.

The workflow stays inactive: the Manual Trigger still works in the editor. No Supabase record, payment, email or customer delivery is touched.

**Spread types:** `three`, `six_questions`, `adaptive_eight`, `tree_of_life`, `twelve_houses`.

nodes.name: 2 · TEST INPUTS — EDIT ME
nodes.notes: Edit only these four values for a Stage 1 test. Supported spreadType values are listed in the nearby note.

nodes.name: 3 · Prepare cards and personal card
nodes.notes: Free cards are deterministic from question + spread. Face-down cards are drawn separately for this test execution. The personal-card arithmetic mirrors server/lib/numerologyEngine.ts and fails explicitly for unsupported names/33.

nodes.name: 5 · OpenAI writes the reading
nodes.notes: Uses the same stored OpenAI credential already wired to the 02 inactive test drive. One report-generation call per manual execution.

nodes.name: 6 · Validate structure and exact draw
nodes.notes: The model returns prose slots only. This node binds them to authoritative saved cards and positions, and fails on missing or extra sections.

nodes.name: 8 · PDFShift creates the PDF
nodes.notes: Uses the stored PDFShift header credential. The output binary property is data.

nodes.name: 9 · REPORT READY — DOWNLOAD PDF
nodes.notes: Successful final node. Open its Binary output and download the data property.
